messages.author: fa52382b9125ca9e
messages.subject: recurring aesthetics error
parts:
Hey guys,

I'm completely stuck and I can't figure out why for the life of me. I'm trying to draw an extremely simple plot but I keep running into this error I can't decypher. The code I'm running is as follows (and should download the csv file automatically):

library(ggplot2)


scrubber = read.csv("https://www.dropbox.com/s/k13zbmbkyrzbv7m/scrubber.csv?raw=1", header = TRUE)


g<-ggplot(scrubber, aes(scrubber$X6am, scrubber$X2pm)) + geom_point(color="blue")
qplot(scrubber, aes(scrubber$X6am, scrubber$X2pm), geom = "jitter")
qplot(scrubber, aes(scrubber$X6am, scrubber$X2pm), geom = "point")

The error is as follows:


Don't know how to automatically pick scale for object of type data.frame. Defaulting to continuous

Don't know how to automatically pick scale for object of type uneval. Defaulting to continuous
Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the dataProblems:aes(scrubber$X6am, scrubber$X2pm)

Has anyone ever seen this before? I've tried everything I can think of, and when I run length(var), it shows that they're both length 15.

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: recurring aesthetics error
parts:
The basic answer is that you're misusing qplot(), which isn't the same
thing as ggplot(); it's intended as a shortcut, and has a different
syntax that normally will never include an aes() call:

qplot(X6am, X2pm, data=scrubber)

As a side note, you can simplify your ggplot example too:

ggplot(scrubber, aes(X6am, X2pm)) + geom_point(color="blue")


Ben
